Name: Log Menu
Author: JareBear8
Description:
[b]Log Menu[/b] is a Stardew Valley mod that adds a Log Menu to display previously seen in-game dialogue. This mod is inspired by the Log/History feature implemented in visual novel games and some RPGs. If you accidentally skipped through a line of dialogue or just want to look at it again, this is the mod for you!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Sn2Dt2p.gif[/img]

[size=5]Install
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]

Press [font=Courier New]L[/font] to display the Log Menu. The 50 most recent dialogue lines will be shown. The Log Menu keybinding, the number of lines displayed, and more are configurable: see the [url=https://github.com/jaredtjahjadi/LogMenu?tab=readme-ov-file#configuration]README[/url] for more information.

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.
[*]Supports mods, including UI changes, custom NPCs, and custom dialogue lines.
[/list]
[size=5]Translations[/size]

Translations are currently available in the following languages:
[list]
[*]French (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/745980]Caranud[/url]﻿) - added in v1.2.2.
[*]Japanese (by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3588405]mitekano23[/url]) - added in v1.2.3.
[/list]
[size=5]Known issues[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][list]
[*][s]During the event in which Linus rummages through trash cans, when Linus asks "Do you think there's something wrong with what I'm doing?" the SMAPI log is continuously spammed with a GameLoop.UpdateTicked error and the question is continuously logged into the Log Menu. This happens until the player chooses a response to the question.[/s] Fixed in mod version 1.2.1.
[*][s]When checking the Fishing Info channel on the TV, the 2nd page of fish information causes GameLoop.UpdateTicked errors in the console.[/s] Fixed in mod version 1.2.3.
[*][s]Log Menu entries that consist of five or more responses overlap the succeeding entries.[/s] Fixed in mod version 1.2.3.
[/list]
[size=5]See also[/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://github.com/jaredtjahjadi/LogMenu]Source code[/url]
[*]If you have any questions or comments about the mod, feel free to reach out to me on Discord (either via DM or in the official Stardew Valley Discord) [font=Courier New]@jarebear1[/font].
[/list]
